scope: Two explicitly read acquisition-guard hunks in src/device.c, original and merge-parent diffs. Source inspection plus bounded fresh-product readiness comparison, not complete session/IRQ acceptance.

reviews.assessment: Only the session-acquisition guard/no-expiry hunk: readiness precedes same-owner reuse; foreign/context-change admission checks pending APDU state without elapsed-time expiry. Rust samples serviced generation at WebUSB command SETUP, retains continuation protection via engine::can_preempt, WebUSB reservation and CCID/HID ownership. E54 exercises fresh unready gate and recovery; existing E32/E34 exercise continuation retention and competitors. Surrounding CAS/reservation/lifecycle hunks remain unreviewed. Original diff uses USBD_CANOKEY_Ready; merge diff uses optional device_usb_ready wrapper.

source_review.observed: Command SETUP acquires APDU interface before preparing RX; status does not acquire it. Empty response fetch stalls. E54 exercises actual USB control routing, with no invalid OUT after rejection.
acquire_apdu_interface calls device_applet_session_acquire before buffer acquisition; a failed session acquisition cannot arm WebUSB RX.
Pinned session acquisition rejects !device_usb_ready even for the same owner, with no elapsed lease expiry; final reservation-sentinel/CAS changes remain outside the two mapped historical hunks.
